test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'MOBILE' is written as 'PRELOH' and 'SILENT' is written as 'VLOHQW', how will 'PAINTING' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​(3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'MOBILE' is written as 'PRELOH'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349a91106e0e555c506bea60cdf5665fd215bf089c1b2da81e6dc7730178fe01.png] 

​And,

 
• 'SILENT' is written as 'VLOHQW'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fd3ea302b9af28fbd34da5bde6f1e0a2e6fb1ae4ad407711abd7d863ecdf03b.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'PAINTING' is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6feadd5f715591cb2707a7883a3dc37c325c2736e0fd4530d6d8120b598b8c8f.png] 

Hence, "**SDLQWLQJ**" is the correct answer.
